…to Paris, where I found that spring (at the time of my sudden flight just hesitating, and standing on tippy toes, and trying to make up her mind) had come to town at last and banished overcoats and brought out flowery hats on the beautiful ladies, and dressed the trees along the street in green, and stuck millions of stiff white or pink, waxy chestnut cones among the leaves, and filled all the air with delicate delicious fragrance.
